sentences.japanese: 今日海岸に行こうと思っていたのに雨が降ってきた。
sentences.english: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.

sentences.japanese: 空模様から判断すると、今日の午後は雨が降るかもしれない。
sentences.english: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain this afternoon.

sentences.japanese: 空模様から判断すると、雨になりそうだ。
sentences.english: Judging from the look of the sky, it is likely to rain.
